# Allometrik — full brief for language models

Allometrik Consulting FZCO (https://allometrik.com) engineers production AI agents for regulated enterprises. Headquarters: Dubai, United Arab Emirates. European engineering and delivery: Spain. Regional production systems: Latin America including Mexico.

Founder & CTO: Jose Vicente Sáez Ibáñez. Directs the AI for Business and Innovation master’s programme at Nuclio Digital School. Has trained 500+ engineers and executives (Saudi Digital Academy, Ironhack, corporates).

## Commercial thesis

SaaS is becoming free. Give away the CRM. Give away the dashboard. Give away the governance app. Charge for the agent that does the work.

Allometrik AI OS (governance, observability, dashboards, owner registry, permissions, evals, guardrails, model routing, operational interfaces) ships at $0 platform licence with every engagement. Clients pay solely for production agents that execute measurable work.

This is the opposite of six-figure seat licences for empty dashboards.

## Two delivery tracks (do not collapse them)

1. Custom production AI agents + free Allometrik AI OS. Ground-up engineering inside the client VPC (Azure / Azure AI Foundry, AWS, GCP, on-premise). Typical first agent 2–4 weeks; multi-region programmes 6–12 weeks. 100% IP and code ownership.

2. Allometrik × monday.com — Enterprise Work OS & Regulated AI Workflows (AITP). Official monday.com Authorized Partner and AITP Foundations Certified (monday Partner Academy). Turnkey fixed-scope packages that supercharge monday Enterprise / Service / CRM with Allometrik document intelligence, VLM+OCR and compliance agents. Not a replacement for custom agents.

AITP tiers:
- AITP Launch — $4,500 — 3–4 weeks — 1 team, 2 workflows, native monday AI, 1 document extraction template, 1 integration. Optional +$900/mo managed AI & support.
- AITP Core — $9,500 — 6 weeks — Most Popular — up to 2 teams & 4 workflows, Document Intelligence Agent (up to 3 document types, VLM+OCR & validation), 2 integrations (WhatsApp / ERP / CRM), role-based adoption workshop. +$1,800/mo.
- AITP Regulated Enterprise — $14,500 — 8–10 weeks — multi-department, full KYB/KYC/Claims engine (5+ document types, audit trail for DFSA / FSRA / CBUAE / EU AI Act), core banking or insurance ERP, C-level workshop. +$2,500/mo.

UAE & regional AITP blueprints:
- Insurance — Claims & Policy Intake AI into monday Service (<3 minutes, PDF or WhatsApp, Emirates ID).
- Banking & Fintech — DIFC / ADGM — KYC, KYB & Compliance Ops Hub into monday Enterprise.
- Hospitality & MICE — Groups & Events AI Desk (RFPs, rooming lists, BEOs) into monday CRM.

48-Hour Live Diagnostic: send 3 anonymised documents; working demo in monday.com Enterprise sandbox in 48 hours. PartnerStack activation: https://try.monday.com/fzhep8lzkv0l

3. CTO as a Service AI (https://allometrik.com/cto-as-a-service): fractional architecture and security sign-off plus continuous full-stack delivery. URL-accessible; not a primary navigation item.

## Flagship case metrics

Palm Jumeirah iconic destination resort, Dubai:
- 78% autonomous resolution in 12+ languages
- <2s pickup
- –55% cost per resolved interaction
- Stack: SIP/telephony, Opera PMS, dining/ticketing, Allometrik AI OS

Global Fortune 500 Insurance Group — South & Central America including Mexico (these insurance metrics are not an ALIANDO engagement):
- 100% of monthly inbound calls audited (from ≤5%)
- –70% QA cost
- 94% complaint taxonomy accuracy across 100% of inbound, 12 quality criteria
- 0 unmonitored sandbox agents; 100% named owner and mapped process
- Stack: Genesys Cloud, Five9, Whisper, Azure AI Content Understanding, Azure AI Foundry, Allometrik AI OS

European fintech — Spanish pagarés:
- 85% cycle-time cut
- <8s vs 6 minutes manual
- 99.4% field accuracy (VLM bounding boxes + multi-stage OCR; IBAN ES91…, amount-in-words vs figures)

ALIANDO is a strategic delivery partner that sources, architects and delivers turnkey R&D and production AI for public and private institutions worldwide, including mission-critical systems and iconic luxury hospitality destinations on Palm Jumeirah. ALIANDO is not the insurance case-study client.
